name: Bot Inbox
description: Every item your Orca bots wait on you for, in one sidebar panel, what needs you first. Answer a bot's question from the panel, snooze an item until tomorrow or next week, see its pull requests, and count what needs you in the status bar.

cover.alt: Four bot chats struck through down to One inbox, beside the panel showing a release question with its proposed replies

screenshots.caption: Answer a bot from the panel, or snooze the item
screenshots.alt: An unfolded item: the bot's question, three proposed replies with the recommended one marked, a field for your own answer, Send answer, Open chat and Snooze
